nodes.text: 10 Questions on the Political and Policy Outlook for 2022 (Phillips)
1. Will Congress pass any reconciliation package this year?
2. Will Congress pass any legislation this year to increase spending?
3. Will any of that legislation boost spending in 2022?
4. What will happen to the expanded Child Tax Credit?
5. Will Congress pass tax increases in 2022?
6. Will Medicare drug pricing be cut?
7 Will Democrats meaningfully weaken (or eliminate) the filibuster in the Senate?
